picks.headline: Alcohol use reduces the efficacy of anti-PD1 immunotherapy by disrupting antitumor immunity
picks.blurb: In mouse models of lung and bladder cancer, moderate-to-heavy ethanol intake cut checkpoint-inhibitor benefit by about half, and a patient lung cancer cohort showed a similar association.

picks.headline: Innate immune memory of past hepatic injury promotes ischemic cardiac inflammation
picks.blurb: Liver-derived palmitic acid and AP-1-dependent epigenetic reprogramming of myeloid progenitors and cardiac macrophages are proposed to carry an inflammatory memory that may affect recovery after a heart attack.

picks.headline: Isomorphic Labs announces Series C investment round
picks.blurb: The AI drug-design company raised $5 billion, co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, to scale its proprietary drug design engine and therapeutic candidate pipeline.

picks.headline: Microbial bile acid deconjugation counters metabolic decline in aging
picks.blurb: Aged mice and human centenarians share a gut-microbe signature of increased bile acid deconjugation, and engineered native bacteria boosting it improved metabolic markers in aged mice.

picks.headline: Plasma proteomics identifies insulin resistance signatures predictive of cardiometabolic disease risk
picks.blurb: Blood protein profiling paired with clamp-based insulin sensitivity measurements yielded a tissue-resolved atlas and a model the authors report beats conventional markers for forecasting metabolic and heart disease.

picks.headline: Opportunistic risk assessment of major osteoporotic fractures from routine chest radiographs using deep learning
picks.blurb: The study asks whether a deep-learning model reading routine chest X-rays can capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where bone density scores and FRAX leave gaps.
